current_prompt.body:
READ the bin packing problem with bin capacity C = 10 and items arriving in order [5, 5, 5, 3, 3, 3, 7, 7]
RUN the First Fit algorithm on the given arrival order and REPORT the resulting packing
DETERMINE an optimal packing that minimizes the number of bins and REPORT it
CALCULATE the gap between the First Fit result and the optimal solution and EXPLAIN why the arrival order causes First Fit to use more bins
INCLUDE a self‑test that VERIFIES both packings use every item exactly once and RESPECT the capacity constraint
